name: Laphin Crober
source: He's not the most intelligent, but sometimes he sees things differently than others. He researches magic that can turn into love. Laphin tends to be a bit of a joker, and gives off a restless impression when he's with people. However, when he's alone and lost in thought, he shows an incredibly serious expression that's hard to imagine under normal circumstances.
